subject: Post-call: Deployment mode & compliance next steps (HIPAA/BAA, SOC2)
messages:
From: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>
To: Jessica Wong <jessica.wong@elarahealth.com>, Raj Patel <raj.patel@elarahealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 18 Apr 2027 10:15:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call: Deployment mode & compliance next steps (HIPAA/BAA, SOC2)

Thanks for the time today — great conversation. Quick recap and proposed next steps to keep momentum: 

Call recap:
- Primary ask: Elara needs a deployment option that meets HIPAA + BAA requirements and provides SOC2 evidence for your procurement team.
- Two likely paths: (1) Redwood Hosted API with SOC2 + BAA, or (2) Dedicated/Private (VPC or on-prem) for stricter network/isolation needs.
- Key constraints you mentioned: audit log retention requirements (7+ years), in-country data residency for PHI, and an upcoming security review with procurement on 4/26.

Immediate next steps (proposed):
1) I will share our latest SOC2 Type II report and a BAA template (attached).
2) If Hosted API is acceptable, we can confirm data residency options and audit log export cadence before your procurement review.
3) If you need Private (VPC/on-prem), we’ll schedule a technical deep-dive with our infra team to scope timelines and network requirements.

Can you confirm which path you want us to prepare for before the 4/26 review? If undecided, we’ll prepare the SOC2/BAA package + a brief notes doc comparing Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private for PHI workloads.

Thanks,
Dylan
Dylan Brooks
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
Mobile: (415) 555-0147
From: Jessica Wong <jessica.wong@elarahealth.com>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>
Cc: Raj Patel <raj.patel@elarahealth.com>
Date: Sun, 18 Apr 2027 13:02:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Post-call: Deployment mode & compliance next steps (HIPAA/BAA, SOC2)

Thanks Dylan — great summary. A few clarifications from my side: 

1) Procurement is leaning toward Hosted API if we can get a BAA + SOC2 Type II and confirmation on audit log retention/export (we need logs retained for 7 years).
2) We do have a hard requirement that PHI must not leave the US for this project. Can Hosted be scoped to US-only regions?
3) If Hosted doesn’t meet the residency/retention guarantees, we’ll need to evaluate Dedicated or Private (VPC/on-prem) — timing for Private would push the project ~3-4 months, so we’d prefer Hosted if acceptable.

Can you send the SOC2 report and the BAA template today? Also, if you have a short one-pager on how Redwood supports US-only residency and long-term audit log exports, that would be super helpful.

Best,
Jessica Wong
Head of Security & Compliance, Elara Health
From: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>
To: Jessica Wong <jessica.wong@elarahealth.com>
Cc: Raj Patel <raj.patel@elarahealth.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 19 Apr 2027 08:17:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call: Deployment mode & compliance next steps (HIPAA/BAA, SOC2)

Jessica — thanks. Attaching the SOC2 Type II (2026), a BAA template, and a short VPC/Hosted comparison deck. High-level answers inline: 

- US-only residency: Yes — Hosted API can be restricted to US regions. We'll include region-specific routing in the contract and enumerate the regions we use.
- Audit log retention: We can provide audit log exports (S3) with retention controls; typical retention windows we support are 1y/3y/7y — for 7 years we’ll work with infra to set export policies and include in the commitment.
- If procurement requires only contractual guarantees and SOC2/BAA signatures, Hosted is normally the fastest path. If they require network isolation or customer-managed KMS/HSM, Dedicated or Private will be required.

Attachments (stubs):
- redwood-soc2-type2-2026.pdf (SOC2 Type II report, executive summary)
- BAA-template.docx (redwood standard BAA — editable)
- redwood-vpc-arch-diagram.png (high-level VPC/private deployment diagram)

Next steps (I suggest):
1) I’ll upload these to a secure DocuSign/Drive link and send to procurement (sending now).
2) Marissa, Neha — can the infra/security team confirm that we can commit to 7-year audit log export for this account and a US-only routing clause? Also need an estimate for time-to-delivery if the customer requests Private deployment.
3) Jessica/Raj — can you share procurement’s security questionnaire (or the specific sections on retention/residency) so we can pre-populate answers?

If it helps, I can also schedule a 30-min technical session this week to walk through the VPC option and timeline.

Thanks,
Dylan

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 19 Apr 2027 09:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call: Deployment mode & compliance next steps (HIPAA/BAA, SOC2)

Looping in Neha for confirmation. Neha — can you confirm by EOD: 
- Whether infra can guarantee a 7-year audit log export for Elara (we usually support S3 exports and retention policies).
- If we can add a US-only routing clause to the contract for Hosted API (should be feasible with region pinning).
- Rough timeline (in business days) to provision Dedicated and Private (on-prem) options so we can give Elara clear expectations if they push away from Hosted.

If all good, Dylan — I’ll prepare a short comparison doc (hosted vs dedicated vs private) with timelines and costs to send to procurement before 4/26.

Thanks — Marissa
